context.project: 150 kW rooftop system on a warehouse

fields.question: Does the bidder itself hold an Ontario electrical contractor licence, as stated in the proposal? A licence held by a subcontractor, partner or a party to be named later does not count.
Does the proposal confirm the bidder has current WSIB clearance?
Does the proposal confirm liability insurance of at least $5M?

How many commercial solar installations of 100 kW or more has the bidder completed in the last 5 years? If the stated period starts before the window given above, give the stated number with status unclear and explain in the note.
What is the total price, in CAD? Note in the note field what the price is stated to include, if anything.
In how many weeks from award will the installation be complete? If no firm duration is given, use null with status not_stated.
How many years is the panel warranty?
How many years is the workmanship warranty?
Does the proposal name, or commit to naming, a project lead or project manager for this project? A role assigned later without a commitment to a named person counts as false.
Does the proposal describe the installation crew (for example its size or certification)?
Does the proposal include a site safety plan?
Does the proposal include ongoing performance monitoring of the system after installation? Progress reports during the build do not count.

mandatory.label: Ontario electrical contractor licence held by the bidder
